messages:
Elaine: @here quick ask — Solace Edge wants to run a 2-week POC. They want to use a 32k-context LLM for extraction + rerank. Can we confirm model/variant compatibility, perf, and a rough pricing ballpark?
Matt: who from SE is owning runtime perf? I can check model variants.
Priya: I’m on it for the POC scoping — customer target 200 reqs/s peak, avg 30 tokens per req, budget conscious. Also asked about SLA for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Nina: model-wise: large open models with 32k context typically available only on dedicated with our sequence-length-enabled variants. We have a quantized variant (mixtral-8x-q4_0-32k) but KV cache behavior differs — needs dedicated GPU to keep latency sane.
Elaine: ok — they want hosted first if possible. Any hosted option for 32k?
Matt: hosted 32k is possible only on our high-memory instances with specific model builds. It's allowed but will be expensive and subject to capacity; fallback to 16k variant is automatic.
Oliver: ops note — for 200 req/s at 30 tokens, batching helps but KV cache + 32k bumps memory a lot. Recommend Dedicated reservation (1x A100-style pool) for predictable latency.
Isabel: security Qs from customer: where is inference data stored, can we turn off telemetry, KMS support for key rotation? I can send the questionnaire answers but need the deployment option answer (hosted/dedicated/private).
Priya: they prefer hosted to avoid infra ops. If hosted is not viable for 32k, we need to propose a hybrid: hosted with fallback to our 16k model and a Dedicated burst for high-context calls. Is that doable?
Nina: hybrid routing possible — policy can route by prompt size. Small prompts -> hosted cheap model; long context -> Dedicated variant. We’ll need to configure fallback models and model tags: e.g. `mixtral-8x-q4_0-32k` (dedicated) and `mixtral-8x-q4_0-16k` (hosted).
Matt: pricing ballpark: hosted 16k variant ~ $0.30 / 1K tokens (generation+context) for this model; dedicated run cost depends on reserved capacity commitment — approx $18k/mo for 1 optimized GPU pool we’d recommend. Exact numbers from finance.
Elaine: can you confirm latency for 32k dedicated at target throughput? Customer needs p95 < 400ms for short outputs.
Nina: p95 looks fine for short outputs if KV cache warmed and batching is tuned. Cold-starts for huge contexts will be higher. We can simulate with their prompt set — please share.
Priya: I’ll upload a trimmed sample prompt set today. SLA ask: they want 99.9 uptime. Is that in scope for Dedicated?
Oliver: yes, Dedicated has SLA options. Need to lock commitment term for higher SLA tiers.
Isabel: on telemetry/KMS — hosted supports customer-managed keys via our KMS integration; we can turn off non-essential telemetry for enterprise. Will prepare answers and checklist.
Matt: action items: (1) Priya -> share sample prompts + QPS profile; (2) Nina -> run perf sim on 32k dedicated variant; (3) Oliver -> cost estimate for 1x reserved pool + burst; (4) Isabel -> answer security questionnaire.
Elaine: thanks all. Priya I’ll loop into the customer call tomorrow at 10am PT.
DeployBot: canary rollout for `mixtral-8x-q4_0-16k` completed on prod-edge (no errors). :white_check_mark:
Priya: thanks — will update after customer call and post the prompt set in this thread.
